reviews.text:
This pet resort is excellent! I've left my dog Leo here multiple times and the care he receives here is top notch.
The cameras provide a good sense of security so I can have eyes on him at all times. I also know that there's plenty of staff around to keep every pet safe and happy.
The facilities are beautiful, great big play area, even a pool! The rooms are also spacious and look comfy for my boy.
I can't recommend this place enough! Also shout outs to Cullen and Sam who take care of all the dogs with excellent care and experience.

My dogs 1st experience went very well. She was nervous at first, which I'm told is normal, but then she went into the pool & as per staff did well for 1st timer. She was 😩 exhausted when we got home. Good!
The staff is friendly, courteous & made me feel comfortable in leaving my dog in their care. There are 2 staff constantly with both groups of dogs watching & ensuring every dogs safety. Highly recommend Somi.

I can’t say enough great things about Somi Pet Resort. From the moment you walk in, it truly looks and feels like a five-star hotel for dogs. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and genuinely cares. They were also super helpful and accommodating, which made the whole experience even better.

One of my favorite features was the webcam access. Being able to check in on Ghost not just in his room but also during playtime gave me so much peace of mind. That alone sets them apart.

Ghost came home completely exhausted, which tells me everything I need to know, he had an amazing time. It’s clear he was well cared for and had a full day of fun.

This will definitely be Ghost’s home away from home whenever I travel. Highly recommend!

I was honestly really nervous about boarding my dog, as she’s recently come from a shelter and has some anxiety, especially around men, and can be a bit reactive at times. I didn’t know how she would adjust in a new environment, so leaving her for a few days was not easy for me.

From the start, the team was incredibly reassuring and understanding. They took the time to listen to my concerns and made me feel confident that she would be in good hands.

When I picked her up, I was so relieved (and pleasantly surprised) to hear that everything went smoothly. There were no incidents, and she was well cared for the entire time. They clearly treated her with patience, respect, and kindness, which means everything to me given her background.

I also appreciated that they offer private accommodations, which allowed me to opt out of group play since I’m still unsure how she does with other dogs. It gave me peace of mind knowing she could have her own space if needed.

As a bonus, she came home freshly bathed and smelled amazing which is always a win.

They came highly recommended to me by two friends, and now I completely understand why. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone, especially if you have a dog with a more sensitive or reactive temperament.

We chose Somi Pet Resort because it looks like they would make our dogs feel like home, because it advertises 24-hour kennel staff, daily housekeeping, and luxury boarding. Instead, we watched through the live suite camera as our dogs were fed breakfast while there was still feces and what appeared to be urine in their suite. The attached screenshots show the waste remained in the room from 7:43 AM until at least 8:28 AM, and the suite wasn’t cleaned until later that morning. Obviously my dogs will not eat if their food is right next to feces or urine. And they did not even send a message of them not touching the food…

Feeding dogs in a soiled suite is a basic sanitation issue and completely unacceptable for a facility that markets itself as a luxury pet resort with 24-hour staff and daily housekeeping.

We ended the stay early because we no longer felt comfortable leaving our dogs there. Although they refunded the unused nights, no one apologized for what we witnessed. We were even charged for baths, yet our dogs came home still smelling dirty.
We paid thousands of dollars expecting exceptional care. Unfortunately, this was not our experience.

A little on the pricey side but the quality of care ends up worth it. I love that for play time they do temperament testing upon first boarding, making sure your dog can get along well with others. They have a well run facility and always clean. They give updates on how your pup does when you come to pick them up, including if there were any scuffles or incidents even if nothing resulted from it, which I really appreciate. It can be costly for long term stays but leaving my high energy dog here for a couple days and paying for the all day play ($10 extra per day), she comes home and knocks out which is what I love to see!

My dog, Lucky, just spent 3 nights at Somi and he had an absolute blast. I'm not sure he wanted to come home! We did the all-day play upgrade and he's been sleeping since he got back. The staff took such great care of him. From start to finish they answered all my numerous questions and I enjoyed being able to watch him play even though the webcam could be a little better.

Today my poppy had her first day at SOMI. When I picked her up something went so wrong. I put her inside my car with my bag,keys and phone inside. Somehow the car locked totally . Mercedes could not remotely helped to unlocked the car. One of the staff members stayed all the way with me helping not only with giving me emotional support but also helping checking on Luna. Finally thank God it was a happy ending. I think the staff is well prepared for situations like this. They are really well trained.

We had a great first boarding experience with Somi. They took great care of our pup, and the prices aren’t bad. We boarded him during a weekend trip and they sent us pictures/ videos of him during playtime and they have webcams available so we were always able to check in on him whenever we wanted (day or night). Facility was super clean and staff was very friendly. We are now planning to take him back for doggy day care and will definitely be using them for future boarding needs as well. Highly recommend.

We boarded our dog Mouse here when we lived in Coral Gables. Somi is incredible.  The time and attention they gave Mouse was awesome.  They make drop off and pick up super easy.  They know all of the dogs that stay with them personally. I was always impressed every time I dropped Mouse off how excited he was to see the staff and how he’d just melt when they picked him up to take him back.

Somi is always super attentive, very communicative. It was great to be able to board him at a place we had so much trust in.

Highly recommend Somi!!

I have boarded my 1 year old German Shepherd here many times and I always have peace of mind that he is in greats hands. I drive all the way from downtown Miami to go to SoMi whenever I need to board my pup because everyone that works there is amazing, the resort is very nice and big and they always take great care of him. Very much worth the price!

This place is truly incredible! A colleague recommended it to me, and I’m so grateful they did. It was my first time ever leaving my two fur babies anywhere. They usually travel with us, but since we were heading to Italy, that wasn’t possible this time.

Michelle, the manager, was absolutely wonderful. She immediately eased my nerves with her patience, kindness, and understanding. My oldest pup had a tough time adjusting at first , she didn’t eat for the first three days. Michelle went above and beyond to make her feel safe and comfortable.

They kept me updated every step of the way, which gave me so much peace of mind knowing my girls were in such caring hands. I can’t recommend this place enough. For all my future international trips, I won’t hesitate. My girls will always stay here where I know they’re truly loved and cared for.  ❤️🐾
And the Camera addition is a huge plus !!!

I wouldn’t want to leave my dog anywhere else. My baby is a 2 year old Dutch Shepherd with a lot of energy. Somi has the space and the right staff to make sure she has her needs met. The staff really makes this place what it is! They treat the pets very well and take the time to understand what they need and adjust to their personality. They also send pictures and videos during her play time which really helps with peace of mind. I would definitely recommend to everyone!

Make sure your dogs bordatela /kennel cough shots are under 6 months and more than 2 weeks. Our dog got kennel cough along with the vets dog, but ours was more than 6 months but under a year. She looks like she had a lot of fun though when we picked her up.

Unfortunately, the resort lied when we inquired if our dog had picked up an eye infection during her stay. A superior of the SoMi Pet Resort stated, and will likely reply to this review stating, that (coincidentally) the eye infection was never observed during the dog’s stay, including the “bath & inspection” on the final day.

Interestingly/Mysteriously/Miraculously, we noticed intense discharge in the dog’s eyes as the dog handler brought the dog to us, and again in the parking lot of the SoMi Pet Resort (which of course is located several miles away from SoMi/South Miami, the name is used as a clever marketing gimmick to signal luxury and safety).

Despite having access to 2 emergency contacts, along with the Vet’s information, we were never made aware of the eye infection until we had to discover it ourselves only moments after the final “bath & inspection”….

As you all know, a lingering eye infection can result in permanent damage to the dog’s eyes.

Our dog had clear signs at the moment we retrieved her and were alarmed enough to go back inside and ask management - they denied any knowledge of an infection, despite clear, “visible to the naked eye,” evidence to the contrary.

Based on their disinformation, we now have no idea how long our dog has been infected.

To the second lie: we visited the pet resort twice prior to our trip and received in-person verbal confirmation, as well as a 3rd confirmation over the phone, that the dog would receive 2-hours of play time. It was not until my emergency contact visited the “resort” (more like dog prison with little jail cells resembling a dog shelter covered in urine) that they informed us the dog was receiving only 1-hour of play time due to it “being the summer.”

Again, an extreme chance coincidence that this was not readily addressed until *after* the dog had checked-in to her little doggie jail cell and the charges began accruing….you will likely hear back from a “Samantha” or a “Michelle” to dispute this review …. But I challenge you to ask yourself, “why would a friendly dog owner take the time to write this review if these statements are not factually accurate?”

Again, this location is nowhere near south Miami and is in fact in the lower demographic and higher crime area near coral way and 79th Avenue.

I will give credit to them that they sent a thorough response to my complaints — of course they denied any and all liability and knowledge of these disappointing actions (LOL)

It is cute the dogs play with other dogs, but “resort” is a term used loosely…imagine the dogs stay in tiny prison cells…picture a typical animal shelter, but with less space inside the room and less separation between cages.

When we toured the space the dog stays in there was actively urine dripping from one dog’s cage into another dog’s cage, separated by a 12”-24” aisle.

And yes, we paid for ann expensive option - the private doggie room, etc.

Sad, to say the least.

I do laugh to myself when I think they had the “nerve” to write in an email to me that they didn’t notice discharge while the dog was in their custody, and that the sickness and eye discharge must have MAGICALLY appeared between the moment we took the dog and arrived at our car in the parking lot.

Proceed with caution, you’ve been warned ….
My pup makes mannnyy friends , he loves it there so much !!! So happy to bring him there any chance I get !❤️🥹

I cannot say enough about how great Somi Pet Resort is if you are looking for a trustworthy place to board your cherished pets! We are very particular about where we board our two fur babies, and we learned about Somi through a nearby dog training facility. We have used them multiple times now and they are amazing! First, the facility is extremely clean. You walk in and it  smells so nice, not like a typical boarding or grooming facility. The staff is extremely friendly and they really seem to care about your pets. Your dogs get playtime with other dogs in a shaded environment that even has a wading pool if your pup likes water! Playtime is supervised very closely by staff so you don't have to worry about aggressive dogs. With regard to the kennels, they are clean, spacious, and you can elect to get one with a camera so you can check in on your pets whenever you want. They also offer grooming services such as baths and nail trims, so your animals can enjoy spa day while you are away!
